title: Wireless Receiver

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Transmits an electric signal without wires to a Receiver

body:
"Wirelessly obtains a signal from a Transmitter and outputs the signal based on the assigned keyphrase"


The Wireless Receiver is a logic component that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics. It receives a electric signal from a Wireless Transmitter based on its keyphrase and outputs it into a wire.

Simply said bluetooth electricity receiver.
